newsitem.title: USA: Vintage Petroleum to buy Alabama properties.
newsitem.headline: Vintage Petroleum to buy Alabama properties.

text.p: Vintage Petroleum Inc said Thursday it agreed to purchase oil & gas producing properties in south Alabama from Exxon Co USA for an undisclosed amount.
The effective date of the transaction is July 1, with closing scheduled for October 31, 1996.
The properties acquired consist of all of the Exxon Corp unit's interests in two fields totaling some 5,000 net acres located in Escambia County and are to be operated by Vintage.
Current net daily production from the properties averages about 1,450 barrels of crude oil and liquids and 2.8 million cubic feet of natural gas.
Activities aimed at improving operational efficiency and exploitation are planned.
Including this transaction, Vintage said, its year-to-date spending for acquisitions totals about $54 million.
